contract: POST /api/session/local-all. Offline batch upload returns one results entry per input, stable IDs for repeats, success/error/progressSynced fields, numeric-string epoch-millisecond timestamps and partial-failure behavior.
exceptions: Mapping only: no tests executed in this invocation. Historical evidence is retained for provenance and does not verify this checkout; named tests are assertion leads, not exhaustive proof of every stated requirement.
force is not applicable: offline batch upload has no force mode.

invariants.contract: POST /api/session/local-all answers 200 {results} with one entry per input in request order: {id, success:true, progressSynced} for a stored session (progressSynced false when the stored progress is newer) and {id, success:false, error} for an unknown item or episode while the other entries still apply; ids stay stable for repeats and play_local_ ids map to one generated id; an empty or absent sessions list answers {results: []}.
exceptions: Assertion leads only; missing normal/error/edge and state-transition proof must be supplied by the owning packet.
